title: Why Pre-Commitment Beats Willpower by 81%
alt_title_1: The 2006 QJE 'Ulysses Pact' Savings Experiment Explained

description_hook: Building on Nobel laureate Thomas Schelling's strategic pre-commitment, economists Nava Ashraf, Dean Karlan, and Wesley Yin showed in a 2006 Quarterly Journal of Economics field study that voluntary withdrawal locks boosted savings balances by 81% in 12 months.

scenes.headline: +81% Higher Savings With Zero Extra Interest
scenes.stat_label: 12-MONTH GAIN FROM ONE SIMPLE ACCOUNT RULE
bullets: Exact same bank interest rate as standard accounts
One voluntary withdrawal rule transformed results
scenes.narration: One simple bank account rule lifted household savings balances by eighty-one percent in twelve months without paying a single extra penny of interest.
scenes.source: Ashraf, Karlan & Yin, 'Tying Odysseus to the Mast', QJE (2006)

scenes.headline: Schelling's Theory & the 2006 SEED Field Study
scenes.stat_label: ASHRAF, KARLAN & YIN COMMITMENT SAVINGS TRIAL
bullets: Schelling: let calm 'Planner You' bind impulsive 'Doer You'
SEED account locked withdrawals until a chosen date or goal
scenes.narration: Building on Nobel laureate Thomas Schelling's pre-commitment theory, economists Nava Ashraf, Dean Karlan, and Wesley Yin tested commitment accounts in a 2006 Quarterly Journal of Economics study that locked withdrawals until savers hit a goal.
scenes.source: Thomas Schelling, Choice and Consequence (1984); Ashraf, Karlan & Yin, QJE (2006)

scenes.headline: One-Tap Transfers Lose to Friday-Night Fatigue
scenes.left_body: Savings 1 tap away in checking -> raided during weak moments
scenes.right_body: Separate bank + 3-day transfer delay -> impulses cool off
scenes.narration: Relying on willpower means fighting the same exhausting battle every Friday night while your savings sit one effortless tap away inside your checking app.

scenes.headline: Add Deliberate Exit Friction While Calm
scenes.stat_label: ZERO FRICTION IN + MULTI-DAY FRICTION OUT
scenes.stat_subtext: Separate institutions protect capital from fleeting moods
scenes.narration: Design a Ulysses Pact while your mind is calm: route payday savings into a separate account with a multi-day withdrawal delay so impulse urges bounce harmlessly.

scenes.headline: Tie Yourself to the Mast Once on Tuesday
scenes.stat_label: ONE STRUCTURAL RULE BEATS 365 WILLPOWER TESTS

Let smart friction guard your compounding floor
